description.text:
In a most gorgeous, romantic estate, surrounded by pristine lakes and deciduous forests all around, Marie painted on the entrance wall of this magnificent historical building.

The task was to create a design that combined the likeness of an etching done of the original medieval castle, by an artist named Vischer in 1681 - and then bring in some context, characteristics and elements of the current surrounding - in this case, all the favorites of the Lady of the house.
